CustomField.description: Populated only on the terminal row GtmAssessmentRequestController.closeDraft appends when the questionnaire is submitted. This is the revocation mechanism: GtmAssessmentDraftController.resumeDraft reads the MOST RECENT row for a token, and if that row has this populated, treats the token as spent and returns null -- without ever updating anything, which a guest cannot do in this org (see Resume_Token__c's description).
CustomField.label: Submitted Request
